counter_increment_rules.unsealing_sessions: Increments from 0 to 1 immediately before the first read operation from the locked-test partition.
counter_increment_rules.model_evaluations: Increments immediately after inference of a checkpoint generates predictions, regardless of subsequent check status.

fault_tolerance_policy.pre_inference_crash: Retryable without incrementing model evaluation counter; partial files are deleted.
fault_tolerance_policy.post_inference_crash: Fail-closed; silent re-run is strictly forbidden once final predictions exist.
fault_tolerance_policy.output_staging: Predictions written to .part file and atomically renamed via os.replace.

environmental_guards.network_isolation: Outbound socket connections strictly blocked (air-gapped assertion).
environmental_guards.read_only_data_mount: Locked-test partition must be mounted read-only.
